summary_en: This study tests a conditioning regimen of fludarabine, melphalan, and total body irradiation (TBI) before an allogeneic stem cell transplant in people with hematologic malignancies. Fludarabine is given on days -5 to -2, melphalan on day -5, and TBI on day -1, and the melphalan and TBI doses vary based on the Hematopoietic Cell Transplant - Composite Risk score, age, and Karnofsky performance status. The record does not state a main outcome; it is a single-arm phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa un régimen de acondicionamiento con fludarabina, melfalán e irradiación corporal total antes de un trasplante alogénico de células madre en personas con neoplasias hematológicas. La fludarabina se administra en los días -5 a -2, el melfalán el día -5 y la irradiación corporal total el día -1; las dosis de melfalán e irradiación varían según la puntuación de riesgo compuesto del trasplante de células madre, la edad y el estado de desempeño de Karnofsky. El registro no indica el resultado principal; es un estudio de fase 2 de un solo grupo.
who_for: Diagnosis of AML, ALL, MDS, CML, NHL, Hodgkin lymphoma, or CLL that needs transplant.
Has a matched related, matched unrelated, haploidentical, or one-antigen mismatched unrelated donor.
Adequate kidney, liver, heart, and lung function, and able to give written informed consent.
not_for: Unable to follow medical recommendations or follow-up.
Active or uncontrolled bacterial or viral infection, as judged by the principal investigator.
Active brain, spinal, or eye disease within 3 months, or primary CNS lymphoma.
Needs changes to the conditioning regimen.
